description: This file defines a custom validator 'FieldMatchValidator' for validating that two fields in an object are equal, typically used in form validation scenarios.

classes.name: FieldMatchValidator
classes.description: A Java class implementing a custom validation constraint to ensure that two specified fields in an object have matching values.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the validator with the field names to compare, retrieved from the annotation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks whether the two specified fields in the object are equal or both null.
